TextBlock.Text: Thimble: Malva, Vicia, come look! Our equipment is missing!
Malva: I double checked that everything was there a minute ago! I saw no storm or wave carry them off.
Vicia: Hypothesis; we are not alone on this planet. An exciting prospect, yet worrying that we have been stolen from so easily...
Thimble: There is not much we can do without what we brought with us, I suggest we leave when we get the opportunity.
